WALL_POWER.title: Wall
WALL_POWER.description: Your Wall's height. It never takes damage. Every [blue]10[/blue] height is a [gold]Section[/gold] that gives [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the end of your turn.
WALL_POWER.smartDescription: Your Wall is [blue]{Amount}[/blue] high: [blue]{Sections}[/blue] {Sections:plural:Section|Sections}, [blue]{SectionBlock}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the end of your turn. It never takes damage.
WALL_STAGE_POWER.title: Construction
WALL_STAGE_POWER.description: Wall stages reached this combat. Their perks stay even if the Wall is torn down.
WALL_STAGE_POWER.stage2: [gold]Brick Wall[/gold]: draw [blue]1[/blue] extra card each turn.
WALL_STAGE_POWER.stage3: [gold]Concrete Wall[/gold]: gain [blue]1[/blue] extra Energy each turn.
WALL_STAGE_POWER.stage4: [gold]Big Beautiful Wall[/gold]: at the end of your turn, deal [blue]1[/blue] damage to ALL enemies per [gold]Section[/gold].
